what_this_is: The data behind diaspora-map.js. Regions and hubs where FED-EDU brothers are building. Edit counts as brothers join — PR the update, build.yml validates.

regions.name: North America
regions.tagline: USA and Canada — Atlanta, NYC, LA, Chicago, Toronto, and every city between.

hubs.note: The anchor hub. First courses tested here; barbershop commission client lives here.
Borough by borough — the Bronx energy is streaming energy.
The I PROMISE-style school pipeline dream lives in this hub's roadmap.
Film and media brothers — the Hollywood matrix runs through this hub.
The Canadian bridge — Caribana to the code.

regions.name: The Caribbean
regions.tagline: Jamaica, Haiti, Trinidad — the islands raised half this community's grandfathers.

hubs.note: Bolt and Bogle country. Tether-first hub — most brothers here are phone-only by default.
Toussaint's island. First-run translation: the coach prompts speak plain, and the community glossary carries the Kreyòl.
Carnival math is league math — the football-stats blueprint found its first users here.

regions.name: West Africa
regions.tagline: Nigeria, Ghana, Senegal — Kunta's coast and Nkrumah's country.

hubs.note: Biggest potential hub on the map. Phone-first by culture — the PWA strategy was designed with Lagos in mind.
Nkrumah's city. The 'learn away, build home' pattern — brothers in the diaspora building for family businesses back home.
French-language bridge hub. The urban-dictionary translation layer runs French + English here.

regions.name: East Africa
regions.tagline: Ethiopia, Kenya, Tanzania — the origin line runs through here.

hubs.note: Obama's father's line runs through this soil. M-Pesa culture means mobile money is native — the hustle-index fees model made sense here first.
Never colonized. The blueprint: infrastructure built own-way. FED-EDU's no-dependency architecture is the same instinct.
Youngest population on the map — the 14-year-old brothers entry point.

regions.name: Europe & UK
regions.tagline: London, Paris, Birmingham — the Windrush line and the new wave.

hubs.note: Windrush descendants coding in the city their grandfathers rebuilt after the war. South London hub forming.
The second UK city — the Caribbean community here mirrors the Kingston hub.
Banlieue brothers — the French translation layer's first users. Same mission, different gatekeepers.

regions.name: South America & Beyond
regions.tagline: Brazil, Colombia — the diaspora the maps forget. FED-EDU doesn't.

hubs.note: Pelé's country. The Portuguese translation layer lives in this hub's roadmap. Largest African-descended population outside Africa.
Palenque descendants — the first free Black town in the Americas. The Spanish layer's anchor.

regions.name: Inside The System
regions.tagline: Brothers with time and a tablet, or coming home soon. The mail-in program runs through this row.

hubs.note: Printed courses + offline HTML files on approved tablets. The physical-raffles safe-shipping checklist covers the physical leg. 15 brothers on the waitlist as of the seed data.
Returning citizens: resume optimizer (Ban-the-Box playbook), the hustle-index first commission priority. Toussaint time applies — there is no too-late.

regions.name: Everywhere Else
regions.tagline: The brothers whose marker is a time zone, not a city — homeless brothers on library terminals, road brothers, the scattered.

hubs.note: The hardware_profiler.py knows the library-terminal profile: no installs, USB stick workflow, 60-minute session limits. The courses are built for the timer.
Truckers, military, touring crews — the PWA offline cache means the lessons ride along.

the_count_note: Counts in this file are seed numbers for launch. The nightly leaderboard_sync.yml workflow and the DAP culture are the real tally — this map updates by PR as hubs report.
membership_reminder: The mission is ALL Black men — Jamaicans, Haitians, Africans, Americans, British; gay and trans brothers; young and old; incarcerated and free; housed and unhoused; every situation. Cultural alignment over melanin math. If a brother's heart is in this work, his marker has a spot on this map.
